alerts.title: Mostly sunny Halloween Saturday, high 62F - rain holds off until after midnight; DST ends tonight
alerts.detail: NWS SLC: slight chance of rain before 09:00, then mostly/partly sunny, high near 62F, S wind 13-15 mph midday. Hourly PoP (feed, confirmed live 06:58): 32% at 05:00, 20% 06:00-08:00, 11% 09:00-11:00, 14% 12:00-14:00, 9% 15:00-17:00; LIVE evening values: 13% at 17:00, 7% at 18:00-20:00, 12% at 21:00-23:00 - below the 40% wet-road threshold at every hour, NO rain adjustment today. The system lands after midnight (first >=40% hour is 00:00 Nov 1 at 47%, rising to ~100%; 0.25-0.50 in) and all day Sunday. DAYLIGHT SAVING ENDS tonight: Sun 02:00 falls back to 01:00 - the 01:00 hour repeats, extending tonight's bar-close demand
